1 Day Lake Naivasha Hells Gate Tour

Package overview

This full-day adventure takes you to the stunning Great Rift Valley, combining the serenity of Lake Naivasha with the dramatic landscapes of Hell’s Gate National Park. Enjoy a boat ride on Lake Naivasha, spot hippos and diverse birdlife, and explore Hell’s Gate on bicycle or game drive — a thrilling way to experience Kenya’s only national park where walking and cycling alongside wildlife is allowed.

  • Lake Naivasha
  • Boat Safari: Cruise the freshwater lake for close encounters with hippos that bob on the surface and vast colonies of majestic birds, including African Fish Eagles.
  • Crescent Island Walking Safari: Enjoy a guided walk among grazing animals (giraffes, zebras, and various antelopes) in a safe, open environment—a unique highlight where you are on foot with the wildlife.
  • Great Rift Valley Views: The drive to Naivasha provides spectacular, sweeping views as you descend into the valley floor.
  • Hells Gate National Park
  • Gorges & Cliffs: Explore the water-carved Ol Njorowa Gorge and admire rock formations like Fischer's Tower and Central Tower.
  • Geothermal Activity: Witness steam vents and hot springs, a result of the area's intense geothermal energy, with the Olkaria Geothermal Station nearby
  • Wildlife: See zebras, giraffes, buffaloes, elands, and over 100 bird species; large predators are rare, making it safe for walking/biking.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Lake Naivasha - Hell's Gate National Park

06:30 AM – Depart Nairobi Your driver-guide picks you up from your Nairobi hotel or residence. Begin your journey toward the Rift Valley with a brief stop at the viewpoint for photography and panoramic views. 09:00 AM – Arrive at Lake Naivasha Upon arrival, head straight for a boat ride on Lake Naivasha . Activities at Lake Naivasha Scenic boat ride on the freshwater lake View hippos , fish eagles , herons , and many other birds Optional visit to Crescent Island Sanctuary (walking safari) 10:30 AM – Drive to Hell’s Gate National Park Proceed to the nearby Hell’s Gate National Park, famous for towering cliffs, rock formations, and geothermal features. 11:00 AM – Explore Hell’s Gate Choose your preferred mode of exploration: Option 1: Biking Safari Rent a bicycle at the park gate Cycle through the park as you enjoy views of zebras, giraffes, gazelles, and buffalos Visit iconic landmarks such as Fischer’s Tower and the Central Tower Option 2: Game Drive Explore the park in your safari vehicle Stop for photos and short walks within the gorge area (if open) 01:30 PM – Lunch Enjoy lunch at a lodge around Naivasha such as: Lake Naivasha Sopa Resort Elsamere Conservation Centre Lake Naivasha Crescent Camp (Alternatively, picnic lunch can be arranged.) 03:00 PM – Optional Activities If time allows, you may enjoy: Visit to Elsamere Conservation Centre Walk along the lakeshore for photography Visit to a nearby flower farm (on request) 04:00 PM – Depart for Nairobi Drop-off at your residence or hotel. End of tour.

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
